key_concepts: Plane mirrors form upright virtual images and show lateral inversion.
Lateral inversion makes left appear right, used in reversed AMBULANCE text.
Multiple images occur when plane mirrors are placed at angles, as in kaleidoscopes.
Parallel plane mirrors can produce an infinite number of images.
Concave mirrors are converging mirrors that focus light to a focal point.
Concave mirrors are used by dentists to magnify teeth and in headlamps, flashlights, and s
Convex mirrors are diverging mirrors with a wider field of view and produce smaller images
Convex mirrors are used in car side mirrors and store corner mirrors.
Convex lenses are converging lenses used in magnifying glasses, cameras, and microscopes.
Concave lenses are diverging lenses that always form virtual images.
In a camera, the photographic film corresponds to the retina of the eye.
